KAKAROTMOD-SAIYAN_BLOOD.title: Saiyan Blood
KAKAROTMOD-SAIYAN_BLOOD.flavor: The more pain, the fiercer the will.
KAKAROTMOD-SAIYAN_BLOOD.description: Gain 1 extra Rage at the start of your first turn each combat. Whenever you play a Strike or take HP damage, gain 1 Rage. Below 20% HP: gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity. End of combat: if your HP is below 70%, heal 6 HP. With enough S-Cells, awaken.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_HEALING_POD.title: Healing Pod
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_HEALING_POD.flavor: Restore the body, reignite the will to fight.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_HEALING_POD.descripti: At the start of each combat, heal 4 HP.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SPACE_SHIP.title: Space Ship
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SPACE_SHIP.descriptio: The first time you play a Skill each combat, draw 2 cards.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_LEGENDARY_LINEAGE.fla: More than rage flows in this bloodline. It carries a conqueror's instinct.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_LEGENDARY_LINEAGE.des: Gain 2 extra Rage at the start of your first turn each combat. Whenever you play a Strike or take HP damage, gain 2 Rage. Max Energy +1. Below 20% HP: gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity. End of combat: if your HP is below 80%, heal 6 HP. With enough S-Cells, awaken.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_CAPSULE1.title: No. 1 Capsule
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_CAPSULE1.flavor: Compact emergency kit. Pop it open the moment you catch your breath.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_CAPSULE1.description: When you enter a Rest Site, heal 6 HP.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DRAGON_RADAR.title: Dragon Radar
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DRAGON_RADAR.flavor: Seven wishes flicker on the glass, plus one more signal from another sphere.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DRAGON_RADAR.descript: On pickup, choose 1 of 8 Shenron cards to add to your deck.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SACRED_WATER_JUG.flav: Catching Korin takes more than brute strength.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SACRED_WATER_JUG.desc: The first time each turn you alternate between an Attack and a Skill, gain 1 Rage and draw 1 card. Powers do not interrupt the sequence.
